title: Dorman 42079 Brake Master Cylinder Reservoir Cap Gasket
description_markdown:
This brake master cylinder reservoir cap gasket is designed to match the fit and function of the original gasket on specified vehicles, and is engineered for durability and reliable performance.

• Direct replacement - this brake master cylinder reservoir cap gasket is designed to match the fit and function of the original gasket on specified vehicles
• Restores functionality - this gasket is made to fit and fully restore part functionality after the original gasket fails
• Durable construction - this part is made from quality materials to ensure reliable performance and long service life
• Trustworthy quality - backed by team of product experts in the United States and more than a century of automotive experience
